w.why: MEASURED at E58 Stage C from A1's OWN mesh (tools/diagnostics/e12_frame.py): worst-of-8-yaws / height = 0.5604 (view 0, the front, essentially equal to the axis-only ratio -- this subject has no diagonal-worse-than-axis effect). 1024 * 0.5604 = 573.9, rounded up to /16 = 576. Deliberately NOT 752 (W3's inherited default): E57's own clay/flat renders used turn_render's unmodified default (752x1024) because no --profile was passed at Stage 2, and this profile's job is to stop that default silently recurring for any future render of this mesh.
